description: Remove the Meta Business Agent from this channel's WhatsApp number. Deletes the agent configuration and, when the last agent on the account is removed, disconnects the integration entirely. Returns {deleted_agent_id}. This is irreversible: knowledge, skills and connectors configured on the agent go with it, and restoring the setup means onboarding again from scratch.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_delete_agent
title: Delete the agent
